## Summary

I updated the create audit line in `ClinicServiceImpl.saveOwner` so it now also logs `membershipLevel` and `membershipNumber`, keeping the existing `id`, `customerCode`, and `registrationDate` fields.

`src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/service/ClinicServiceImpl.java:315`:
```java
if (isCreate) {
    String membershipNumber = Owner.membershipNumber(owner.getCustomerCode(),
        owner.getRegistrationDate());
    int membershipLevel = Owner.membershipLevel(Owner.membershipPoints(
        owner.getNamesakeCount(), owner.getEmail(), owner.getHouseholdCount(),
        owner.getRegistrationDate()));
    AUDIT.info("owner created id={} customerCode={} registrationDate={} "
            + "membershipLevel={} membershipNumber={}",
        owner.getId(), owner.getCustomerCode(), owner.getRegistrationDate(),
        membershipLevel, membershipNumber);
}
```

The values are derived the same way the `OwnerMapper` computes them for the API response (`Owner.membershipNumber(...)` and `Owner.membershipLevel(Owner.membershipPoints(...))`), so the audit line matches what the owner endpoint reports. The test suite passes (`BUILD SUCCESS`, `Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0`), and the emitted log confirms the new fields, e.g. `owner created id=11 customerCode=NSW-16E6609E registrationDate=2026-10-01 membershipLevel=2 membershipNumber=NSW-16E6609E-M26`.
